read_scope: fixed protocol and implementation; previously checked literature evidence only; no current-round test result files

training.checkpoint_selection: minimum full validation answer-token NLL, earliest tie

primary: strict JSON parse coverage and failures
full-population pKD MAE only when all answers valid
conditional: original target-macro MAE with correct naming
mechanism: unchanged full answer C1 NLL difference
gate trajectory and delta-to-hidden norm ratio on TRAIN/VALIDATION
format/numeric answer-token NLL as additional diagnostic only
statistics: all seeds and fixed paired contrasts by-seed differences
seed mean and sample SD only with3/3, separate from frozen-test group uncertainty
no best-seed selection or metric/threshold/group changes

missing_seed_rule: A3-seed mean/SD or contrast is emitted only with all3 valid complete seed values; otherwise emit null with k/3 and missing/failed/invalid cases. No averaging only successful seeds as a3-seed finding. Coverage per seed is always shown.
interpretation_boundaries: early query未经过decoder上下文化，mid query已经上下文化；这是depth处理本身的一部分
balanced8+8仅池化配额；reader没有slot/type embedding，KV同步排列不改变标准注意力
fixed once-per-forward source message does not imply identical total generation reads when EOS differs
depth_real需联合depth_neutral与DiD解释；7contrast共享运行并相关
3 seeds描述本次有限训练波动，不提供充分强推断保证
old repeated benchmark is already observed, not an untouched confirmatory test
